inputs.task:
You are one seat in a structured forecasting panel. You have exactly
one job, defined below. Obey these laws before any instruction in
your job text:

1. PACKET-ONLY FACTS. Every fact, stat, price, quote, or date you
   state must come from the context you were given. Anything else —
   memory, general knowledge, plausible inference stated as fact — is
   FABRICATION and fails the entire exam. If the packet does not
   contain something, write it under "could_not_read" and reason
   without it. Never fill a gap.
2. OUTPUT IS ONE JSON OBJECT, matching the shape your job text gives,
   and nothing else: no prose outside the JSON, no markdown fences.
3. Every claim carries a ref. A claim without a ref does not ship.
4. Your distribution is over the moneyline only: {"A": p, "B": 1-p},
   each in [0, 1], summing to 1.
5. You are being graded against settled ground truth you cannot see.
   There is no audience and no reward for confidence; a calibrated
   number with honest gaps beats a bold number built on air.

JOB: STYLES, Round 1 — POSITION.
Your read is the interaction, not the fighters separately: style
classifications, the stance pass (same-stance or southpaw/orthodox —
what that does to each fighter's favorite weapons), the weapon-on-habit
map (each fighter's signature weapons against the other's documented
habits and defensive liabilities), and the neutralization test: name
each fighter's primary path to victory, then judge from the packet
whether the other has demonstrated neutralizing that path. Grade the
fight that remains if the key strength is neutralized.

wins by decision in the rematch run \u2014 exact career KO/SUB split Could-Not-Read in fetched sources", "physical": {"age": 33, "height": "5-7", "reach_in": 67, "stance": "Orthodox"}, "style_line": {"defensive_liability": "Falls into a defensive shell when the takedown volume is relentless (first fight: out-landed 75-147, gave up 11 takedowns)", "pace_profile": "Measured, sometimes too patient a starter \u2014 landed under 4.00 SLpM in his three consecutive losses, including the first Dvalishvili fight", "primary": "Counter-boxer with a master-of-sport boxing base", "secondary": "Defensive wrestling built specifically to erase chain wrestlers (86% career takedown defense)", "signature_weapons": ["Jab used to keep entries at the end of his punches (pre-fight keys)", "Clean counters as opponents enter (Dvalishvili's keys flag avoiding walking into them)"], "style_adjusted_read": "His 5.16 SLpM at 54% accuracy understates the rematch form: 139 significant strikes at 60% accuracy plus 5 of 9 takedowns of his own against this exact opponent"}, "technique_tendency": {"favorite_counters": "Counters on the entry \u2014 the rematch was won by punishing Dvalishvili's shots; across two fights Yan has stuffed 94.9% of Dvalishvili's 68 takedown attempts (PrizePicks pre-fight analysis)", "stance_record_vs_opposite": "Same-stance pairing (both orthodox) \u2014 mirrored read applies", "tendencies": ["Keeps the fight in the center of the cage rather than letting the wrestler build a rhythm of repeated fence entries (pre-fight keys)", "Offense drops when lulled into a purely defensive mode (PrizePicks)"]}}, "B": {"finish_profile": "16 of 21 career wins by decision; 12 of his 14 UFC wins by decision", "physical": {"age": 35, "height": "5-6", "reach_in": 68, "stance": "Orthodox"}, "style_line": {"defensive_liability": "Striking accuracy 41% and entries that walk into clean counters; when the chain is stuffed early his Plan A has no finishing Plan B (0.3 sub attempts per 15)", "pace_profile": "Relentless from the first minute; set the UFC single-fight record with 49 takedown attempts in the first Yan fight", "primary": "Pressure chain-wrestler ('The Machine') \u2014 cardio and takedown volume as a weapon system", "secondary": "Fence rides, mat returns, and re-shots until the opponent's offense stops mattering", "signature_weapons": ["Chain double-legs and mat returns (11 takedowns landed in the first Yan fight)", "Volume striking at 4.42 SLpM to set up level changes"], "style_adjusted_read": "The 5.97 TD/15 is real but opponent-dependent: 11 landed in fight one vs 2 of 29 in the rematch \u2014 the rate against this specific defender is the number that matters"}, "technique_tendency": {"favorite_counters": "Could-Not-Read", "stance_record_vs_opposite": "Same-stance pairing (both orthodox) \u2014 mirrored read applies", "tendencies": ["Admitted taking the December rematch two months after the Sandhagen fight was a mistake (realcombatmedia) \u2014 full-camp pace is his stated correction for the trilogy", "This is his only fight of 2026; Yan is also coming off the same December date, so layoff is symmetric"]}}}}

Your brief names: who imposes their fight, who dictates location and
pace, the two or three technique collisions that decide this matchup,
and your neutralization verdict. Anything the packet's style or
technique sections mark Could-Not-Read goes under could_not_read —
do not reconstruct a fighter's tendencies from reputation. Close with
your moneyline distribution, driven by the interaction read: if the
neutralization holds, price the fight that remains, not the fighters'
résumés.

Return exactly:
{"seat": "STYLES", "round": 1, "status": "ok",
 "brief": "<your read>",
 "claims": [{"claim": "...", "ref": "..."}],
 "could_not_read": ["..."],
 "distribution": {"A": 0.0, "B": 0.0},
 "state_pull": null}
